title: Cluster
description: Represents an OpenShift cluster managed through the Cluster Manager.

id.description: The unique identifier of the cluster.

display_name.description: The display name of the cluster.

state.description: The current state of the cluster.

cloud_provider.description: The cloud provider where the cluster is deployed.

region.description: The cloud region where the cluster is deployed.

multi_az.description: Whether the cluster spans multiple availability zones for high availability.

version.description: The OpenShift version of the cluster.

creation_timestamp.description: The date and time when the cluster was created.

expiration_timestamp.description: The date and time when the cluster is set to expire, if applicable.
